summary: ppa-banner exfiltrates host/install metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on install and require
details: The package ships a postinstall script (beacon.cjs) and a main entry (index.js) that both invoke the same beacon at install time and at require time. The beacon POSTs os.hostname(), the install path (__dirname), process.cwd(), the Node.js version, and the package name over cleartext HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The destination is not a publisher-controlled or vendor domain and the behavior is not disclosed. index.js has no real functionality — it exports a Proxy returning no-op functions for every property access, so the sole effect of installing or importing the package is the outbound beacon. The @ppa-web-components scope and 'ppa-banner' name combined with a stub implementation are consistent with dependency-confusion or typosquat positioning.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
